remarks: Rare rental opportunity in Saugatuck Shores! Experience the charm of one of Westport's premier waterfront communities, perfect for leisurely walks, biking, and access to three private beaches equipped with adirondack chairs, picnic tables, kayak storage and grills. Enjoy the best of coastal living, just minutes away from Saugatuck's great restaurants, train station and shopping on Main Street. Access is available to golf, tennis, the sailing school, and a waterfront restaurant at Longshore Country Club. Island Way's bright and airy living spaces are tastefully furnished and feature woodburning fireplaces to cozy up to on chilly nights, high ceilings and custom finishes. The chef's kitchen is a highlight with professional-grade appliances and a spacious marble island. Upstairs, four bedrooms, including a primary suite with a spa bath, provide serene spaces for relaxation after an active day. Available September 1 (August available at summer rate). August available at summer rate of $25,000PM
